colors.role: Deeper violet for secondary borders and gradient origins — bridges Cosmic Violet into the atmospheric range

colors.name: Aurora Teal
colors.role: Atmospheric teal pulled from the hero photography — background washes and the emotional color of the brand

colors.name: Cyan Glow
colors.role: Terminal stop of the radial atmospheric gradients — recreates the directional key light of the hero at smaller scales; Decorative radial gradient that recreates the hero's directional teal light in section panels

colors.name: Cosmic Violet Wash
colors.role: Decorative violet gradient for atmospheric panels

colors.name: Polar White
colors.role: Primary text on the dark hero, light section surfaces, card backgrounds, button text on violet

colors.name: Obsidian
colors.role: Text on light surfaces and deepest contrast points

colors.name: Silver Slate
colors.role: Near-gray stroke color for subtle decorative lines and secondary UI elements

colors.name: Cerulean Mist

colors.name: Storm Shadow

surfaces.name: Hero Atmosphere
surfaces.purpose: Full-bleed dark photographic canvas — the emotional base, paired with teal key lighting and white floating text

surfaces.name: Aurora Teal Panel
surfaces.purpose: Tinted atmospheric section background created via radial white-to-teal gradient washes

surfaces.name: Polar Surface
surfaces.purpose: Content section base — lets violet typography and clean components speak without atmospheric interference

components.name: Hero Atmosphere Section
components.description: 100vh dark photographic background with deep teal-cyan key lighting on a profile portrait. Centered headline at 80px TWKLausanne-200 weight 400 in white with -3.2px tracking, floating in negative space. Optional right-aligned description at 12px TWKLausanne-250 white. No card, no panel, no border — the photograph is the container.

components.name: Outlined CTA Button
components.description: 20px border-radius, 1px solid Cosmic Violet #1b2978 border, transparent background, 16px 24px padding. Text at 12px NeoSansPro-Medium uppercase, 0.16em letter-spacing, white fill. Optional 5px gap to a left-arrow icon. The system's only interactive primary action — never a filled rectangle.

components.name: Architectural Nav Link
components.description: Plain text at 10px NeoSansPro-Medium uppercase, 0.32em letter-spacing, white fill, no underline. Sits at 9px right margin to an adjacent grid utility icon. Hover shifts letter-spacing or color to Cosmic Violet — never a background fill.

components.name: Brand Wordmark
components.description: Text 'AMATERASU' at 10px NeoSansPro-Medium uppercase, 0.32em letter-spacing, white, centered horizontally at the top of the viewport with ~20px top padding. No logo icon, no image — pure typographic mark relying on extreme letter-spacing to carry brand presence.

components.name: Scroll Cue
components.description: Text 'SCROLL TO EXPLORE' at 10px NeoSansPro-Medium uppercase, 0.32em letter-spacing, white, anchored bottom-left of the hero. Often paired with a thin down-arrow stroke icon at 5px left margin.

components.name: Atmospheric Gradient Panel
components.role: Tinted content section using radial light wash
components.description: Full-width section with background built from radial-gradient(at 5.62% 33.12%, #ffffff 30%, #84cdee 100%), 100–150px vertical padding, white or Cosmic Violet text floating over the wash. Replicates the hero's directional teal key light at section scale.

components.name: Content Section (Light)
components.description: Polar White #ffffff background, 40–60px vertical padding, heading at 40px TWKLausanne-250 weight 400 in Cosmic Violet #1b2978 with -0.025em tracking, body at 16px TWKLausanne-250 weight 400 in Obsidian. No card

typography.role: Body, UI, and mid-tier headings — the workhorse family. 400 for paragraphs and descriptions, 700 for sub-headings and emphasized labels. The tight 1.13 line-height at 40px gives mid-headings a compressed, architectural feel

Display and hero headlines — the lightest cut of TWKLausanne acts as an anti-convention choice: most brands shout at 80px with bold weights, this one whispers at 400 and achieves presence through restraint and aggressive negative tracking
typography.substitute: Inter Tight 200, Manrope 200, or any geometric sans at its lightest available weight

typography.role: Architectural all-caps labels — nav links, scroll cues, section markers, brand wordmark. The 2.0–3.0 line-height at 10px creates dramatic vertical breathing room, and the extreme +0.32em tracking turns tiny text into spatial markers rather than readable labels
typography.substitute: Space Grotesk 500 uppercase with manual letter-spacing, or any geometric sans applied uppercase with wide tracking

typography.role: Arial — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

description: Amaterasu lives inside a cinematic dark photograph: a full-bleed teal-lit profile portrait washes the viewport in deep cyan atmosphere, and a single deep cosmic violet (#1b2978) is the only structural ink in the system. Typography splits into two contrasting registers — a whisper-weight display face (TWKLausanne-200) locks headlines tight against the dark at 50–80px with aggressive negative tracking (-0.040em to -0.025em), while a wide-tracked all-caps label face (NeoSansPro-Medium) floats small nav and scroll cues at 10–12px with extreme +0.16em to +0.32em letter-spacing. Components stay deliberately thin: 20px-radius pill controls with violet hairline outlines instead of heavy filled blocks, white text floating in 40–60px negative space, and zero box-shadow elevation. The palette is a disciplined two-ink system (Polar White + Cosmic Violet) with teal appearing only as atmospheric photographic light and gradient washes — never as a UI surface, button, or text color.

customSections.title: Agent Prompt Guide
customSections.content:
primary action: #1b2978 (outlined action border)
Create an Outlined Primary Action: Transparent background, #1b2978 border and text, 9999px radius, compact pill padding. Use it for the main CTA instead of a filled button.

elevationPhilosophy: This system deliberately avoids box-shadows entirely — depth and separation are achieved through the full-bleed dark photographic hero, atmospheric teal gradient washes, and hairline Cosmic Violet borders on outlined components. The flat treatment is intentional: it keeps the brand feeling like a clinical neuroscience space rather than a typical SaaS dashboard. No card has ever needed a drop shadow; no modal has ever needed a glow.
